quarterly_data.signal: Company: as global big tech rapidly builds AI data centers, the power infrastructure behind AI is growing structurally, and Gaon Cable is expanding power cable and busduct supply through US subsidiary LSCUS via long-term supply agreements and direct deals with global big tech, strengthening its position as a core supplier to AI power infrastructure. LSCUS H1 2026 revenue KRW 288,358,150 thousand (H1 2025 KRW 211,154,100 thousand), net income KRW 21,620,346 thousand; power-segment North America revenue KRW 333,764,170 thousand (H1 2025 KRW 266,634,661 thousand). H1 2026 R&D included CSA (Canada) certification of the GAON Cable Bus (GCB) series.
